run_consolidate_checkpoints: run the consolidate script with --ckpt to merge distributed PLM checkpoint shards into one file
build_model_from_checkpoint: build an LMTransformer model from a checkpoint directory by loading its params.json config
load_model_state_dict: load the model state dict from a checkpoint directory using load_from_checkpoint
save_consolidated_state_dict: save the consolidated model state dict to a .pth file using torch.save
review_consolidate_workflow: review the consolidate module that builds a model, loads weights, and saves a single consolidated checkpoint
